financings_after_balance_sheet.what: ATM sales of ~9.2 million shares under B. Riley Sales Agreement, Apr 1 - May 5, 2023
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: During the period of April 1, 2023 through May 5, 2023, we sold approximately 9.2 million shares of our common stock under the Sales Agreement, totaling net proceeds of approximately $13.6 million.
